decisions: New six-wheel family with tandem rear axles and independently owned opposite-side paint.
Observed smaller rear caps use smaller circular wheels and inset rear tracks; physical dimensions remain diagnostic, not gameplay colliders.
Rear loader is a separate hinge assembly with an actual recessed mouth and diagonal braces; animated clearance is unqualified.
One amber warning beacon uses the existing isolated lens effect contract. Repeated opposite-view lamp placement is a source contradiction; south/west reverse a fixed physical lamp.
Source cab roof and container projection are stylized; hidden faces and roof cleanup are explicit palette inferences.
Independent orange source owner; 34 west cab-edge alpha pixels differ from green and require an explicit cab-edge fit, not a recolor bypass.

West crop has a measured four-pixel left registration; lower west cab edge extends one model unit at z8..30. Other three own silhouettes equal green after trimming; this is independent fitting, not strict recolor eligibility.
Unseen container-front palette uses orange source tones, never green-template colors.
East crop is independently registered four pixels right of green; wheel measurements and UV paint use that origin.
limits: Affine owned UV paint is cleaned authoring, not ray-visible recovery. Own projection/coverage remains separate.
